item.title: New York Runs On…Oat Milk?
item.description: Despite the fads of caffeinated refreshments, Oatly oat milk has held steady as the non-dairy beverage of choice and perhaps the most consistent sight of cafés citywide. Creamy without trying too hard and sustainable without being preachy about it, it’s the quiet backbone of countless NYC coffee rituals—and now the cornerstone of countless normcore fits with its latest capsule collection with streetwear brand, Kids of Immigrants.
